name: iact_gammacas_magic_lst1
label: gamma Cas on MAGIC-I + MAGIC-II + LST-1 at 425 nm: the VERITAS ellipse (major axis, axis ratio, PA) over three nights with MAGIC's analog correlator
notes: The three surveyed baselines (MAGIC-I-II 85 m, LST-1 54 and 106 m from MAGIC-II and -I) sweep different position angles through the 10.6 h night; the Fisher matrix on (theta_major, axis ratio, PA, N0) accumulates over three consecutive nights.
Sensitivity per station: MAGIC 236 m^2, q 0.304, QE 0.295 (Abe et al. 2024); LST-1 370 m^2, q 0.64, QE 0.40 (CTAO-N tables); MAGIC's correlator chain (110 MHz, F 1.15, sigma_spec 0.87).
